Question: Assalaam-alaikum I Wanted to ask you about my dream please say the tabeer of it first I saw a few honey bees and after that me and my brother started journey and a person asked him for a blanket I told him to give from throwing from the train but he but down and he missed the train so on the next station i to got down and again i started a journey to get him but the train diverted and came to a place named as "allow" there I saw the dargah and I again sat on the train it took me to the next station there was another dargah and very few people than the dargah I visited earlier. Then I again came back to my home and after few time my brother to came back .To inform you that my brother is in jamaat now and I was eager to go but due to some reason I cant is this some confusing dream good bad or shaitan's handiwork. Answer ID: 5423 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 976/976=H) The meaning of the dream is that you and your brother will get benefit while struggling in religious deeds. And if you face some troubles, they also will soon vanish away, In-sha-Allah. In the dream, there is a forewarning that the majority of those visiting graves of pious men do not have religious objectives i.e. they do not observe the Islamic instructions and rules. May Allah Almighty keep you and us from all kinds of abominations! Amen Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
